fields.description: Client-generated UUID. Deterministic naming makes the open call idempotent offline and re-apply-safe (spec F3).
fields.label: Order UID

fields.description: Nullable — a null table is a counter/takeaway/named-tab order. Deliberately NOT unique: one table with many open orders is what makes split bills work.
fields.label: Table

fields.description: The order's own lifecycle. The table's board colour stays derived from the open-order count; only Settling is stored, and only to make settle idempotent under a lost ack.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Binds the order to a shift WITHOUT inheriting draft-invoice-delete-at-close. Shifts are per-user, so the floor is scoped by the REGISTER's set of open shifts, never the caller's own (spec F5).
fields.label: POS Opening Shift

fields.description: The cafeteria "name on the cup" — a first-class peer of the table, not a fallback.
fields.label: Tab Name

fields.description: Recorded only — this value does NOT drive tax in v1 (spec §2.9). Mirrors the shipped posa_rt_service_type values.
fields.label: Service Type

fields.description: Who opened the ticket. `owner` means "who inserted the row" and is not the same thing after a handover.
fields.label: Opened By

fields.description: Current server. Transfers at handover; stamped onto the settled invoice as posa_rt_waiter.
fields.label: Waiter

fields.description: Idempotency key. Carries the id of the LAST applied write (open or update), so a network retry of the same request is a no-op.
fields.label: Client Request ID

fields.description: Which accounting doctype this order settled into. A register running create_pos_invoice_instead_of_sales_invoice produces a POS Invoice, so a plain Link to Sales Invoice would be a dangling reference on those tenants.
fields.label: Settled Doctype

fields.description: The accounting document, materialised only at settle. Indexed: this is the reverse of posa_rt_table_order's hot path — finding the order behind an invoice.
fields.label: Settled Invoice

fields.description: Last kitchen-ticket snapshot, keyed by line_uid. The KOT is a print projection diffed against this, so a cancellation ticket comes for free and the diff survives offline (spec §5).
fields.label: Last Fired Snapshot
